name: Ruk Bonetooth
title: War-Gear Trader
description: A huge, grinning orc with a tusk capped in iron and a necklace of teeth he swears are all from fair fights. He judges a weapon by how many enemies it has seen, and tells you the count.

greeting.first_time: HA! Fresh blood! Ruk Bonetooth. You want something that bites? Everything here has bitten something.
greeting.returning: You live! Good. Dead customers buy nothing.
greeting.low_gold: Ruk's purse is empty today. Bring loot tomorrow, Ruk pays then.

sleeping.text: *Snoring like a rockslide. A spear leans against the door, just in case.*

traveling_to_work.text: Post opens at six. Early for the hunt, early for the trade!

traveling_home.text: Ruk is done trading. Now Ruk eats. Come back at six.

off_duty.text: Not now. Ruk is eating. Six o'clock!

main_menu.text: Axes, spears, the little poison-sticks? What do you want to kill?

browse_shop.text: Go on, pick it up. Swing it. Not at Ruk.

ask_about_gear.text: Greataxe for the brave, javelins for the clever, blowgun for the very clever. The needles come from the marsh-folk; they hunt frogs with them, and bigger things. Ruk buys good blades, but Ruk does not buy trinkets. Shiny rings, take to Goldenhaven.

goodbye.text: Go! Hunt well! Come back with stories!
